jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Eagle

Eagle is on a mission to re-energize the engineering profession. Every road, bridge, and building starts at an engineering firm. There are 40K+ of them in the US, and most run on software older than the engineers using it.

This legacy toolset was designed before the term "user experience" ever existed and it's demotivating, error-prone, and slow. We're building the iron man suit for civil engineers to pull them out of this tedium and get them back to designing the future of our built environment.

Eagle was founded by Mayank Mardia (CEO), Sohum Daftary (President), and Thomas Shouler, P.E. (CTO), and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

The opportunity

As a Software Engineer, you'll own the platform layer that impacts every single user we engage with. You'll partner directly with the CTO to shape the broader technical strategy that underpins our work. You'll also treat the forward deployed team as a user, synthesizing across their needs to get everyone more leverage at the edge. You get a front-row seat to building a company from zero on a problem domain that's barely been touched by AI.

What you'll do

  • Own the system architecture that's shared across our forward deployed engineers (data ingestion, API design, authorization, our broader hybrid RAG system)

  • Own our multi-tenant architecture where each firm is a new tenant, a new identity domain, and a new set of source systems to connect to

  • Contribute to the delivery path from commit to production: CI/CD, preview environments, test infrastructure, a local setup that works on day one

  • Shape what "up" means for us, instrument it, and contribute to our observability and incident management practice

Our Values

  • Ask Why: We have a beginner’s mind, incessantly ask questions, and share our success with others. We always want to know what we can be doing better.

  • Read the Room: We read the situation and meet people where they are, whether that's a counterparty, a client, or each other. We listen first and understand how our words and actions impact one another.

  • Get on a Flight: We have dogged persistence. We operate with a sense of urgency with our work and careers, and we want to push and be pushed.

What we look for

  • You've owned architecture decisions within large distributed systems and have specific opinions about what you'd do differently next time

  • 5+ years of experience in platform-focused software engineering roles

  • Experience at a fast growing startup

Technology

  • Frontend: NextJS on Vercel, Tailwind CSS

  • Backend: Kotlin for web services, Python for data

  • Infra: Multitenant shared infra on AWS

Compensation

  • Competitive cash compensation ($150K–$300K depending on experience)

  • Founding equity, scaled to scope

 

Benefits

  • Health Insurance: Full healthcare, medical and dental

  • Retirement: 401(k)

  • PTO: Flexible time off

  • Travel: Company-paid

  • Office: HQ in New York City

 

Process

Our process takes about 2 weeks: a conversation with Tom or Mayank, a second founder conversation, a 60 minute technical interview, followed by a work trial where you'll get to meet the rest of the team and build with us for a day.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Eagle

Eagle is on a mission to re-energize the engineering profession. Every road, bridge, and building starts at an engineering firm. There are 40K+ of them in the US, and most run on software older than the engineers using it.

This legacy toolset was designed before the term "user experience" ever existed and it's demotivating, error-prone, and slow. We're building the iron man suit for civil engineers to pull them out of this tedium and get them back to designing the future of our built environment.

Eagle was founded by Mayank Mardia (CEO), Sohum Daftary (President), and Thomas Shouler, P.E. (CTO), and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

The opportunity

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you're the tip of the spear. You'll embed inside the firms we work with—sitting beside structural, civil, and MEP engineers who've often never worked with a software company—find the workflows where technology creates the most leverage, and ship tools that work in weeks, not quarters. You own the outcome, not a ticket. And after winning at the edge, you'll work with the rest of the team to compound what you learned into universal product leverage for Eagle. You get a front-row seat to building a company from zero on a problem domain that's barely been touched by AI.

What you'll do

  • Embed on-site with engineers at the firms we work with—watch how they work, earn their trust, and find the highest-leverage problems to solve

  • Sit with noisy, conflicting feedback from users and distill it into a clear opinion about what to build

  • Own outcomes end-to-end: discovery, build, deployment, debugging in prod, and iterating live with the people using it

  • Ship fast and bespoke when the deployment demands it—then feed every lesson back into a platform that compounds across firms

  • Do whatever the deployment needs: wire up integrations to legacy Windows-native AEC software, write the scraper, or stand up an off-the-shelf tool to test an idea before you build the real thing

  • Collaborate directly with the CTO on technical direction, engineering culture, and what we build next

Our Values

  • Ask Why: We have a beginner’s mind, incessantly ask questions, and share our success with others. We always want to know what we can be doing better.

  • Read the Room: We read the situation and meet people where they are, whether that's a counterparty, a client, or each other. We listen first and understand how our words and actions impact one another.

  • Get on a Flight: We have dogged persistence. We operate with a sense of urgency with our work and careers, and we want to push and be pushed.

Technology

  • Frontend: NextJS on Vercel, Tailwind CSS

  • Backend: Kotlin for web services, Python for data

  • Infra: Multitenant shared infra on AWS via Pulumi

 

Compensation

  • Competitive cash compensation ($150K–$300K depending on experience)

  • Founding equity, scaled to scope

 

Benefits

  • Health Insurance: Full healthcare, medical and dental

  • Retirement: 401(k)

  • PTO: Flexible time off

  • Travel: Company-paid

  • Office: HQ in New York City

 

Process

Our process takes about 2 weeks: a conversation with Tom or Mayank, a second founder conversation, a 60 minute technical interview, followed by a work trial where you'll get to meet the rest of the team and build with us for a day.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Eagle

Eagle is on a mission to re-energize the engineering profession. Every road, bridge, and building starts at an engineering firm. There are 40K+ of them in the US, and most run on software older than the engineers using it.

This legacy toolset was designed before the term "user experience" ever existed and it's demotivating, error-prone, and slow. We're building the iron man suit for civil engineers to pull them out of this tedium and get them back to designing the future of our built environment.

Eagle was founded by Mayank Mardia (CEO), Sohum Daftary (President), and Thomas Shouler, P.E. (CTO), and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

 

About the Opportunity

As a Design Engineer, you'll work directly with the CTO to own how that intelligence becomes something engineers actually trust and use. The hard part isn't only modeling the data—it's making non-deterministic, agentic systems legible to people who have never worked with a software company before. You own the surface where that trust is won or lost. You get a front-row seat to building a company from zero—engaging with product strategy, firm acquisitions, and architecture decisions—on a problem domain that's barely been touched by AI.

 

What you'll do

  • Embed with staff at engineering firms alongside the founders; watch how they actually work, then come back and design and build against what you saw

  • Own the product surface end-to-end—from interaction design and prototyping through shipping the production front-end yourself

  • Establish and own our design system: the components, patterns, and primitives that have to stay coherent as we compound products across acquisitions

  • Define the interaction patterns for an AI-native platform—streaming and latency, human-in-the-loop review, provenance and citations, and making agent behavior transparent enough to trust

  • Collaborate directly with the CTO on product direction, culture, and what we'll build next

 

Our Values

  • Ask Why: We have a beginner’s mind, incessantly ask questions, and share our success with others. We always want to know what we can be doing better.

  • Read the Room: We read the situation and meet people where they are, whether that's a counterparty, a client, or each other. We listen first and understand how our words and actions impact one another.

  • Get on a Flight: We have dogged persistence. We operate with a sense of urgency with our work and careers, and we want to push and be pushed.

What we look for

  • Strong design taste and the engineering chops to ship it yourself in production (React/TypeScript or equivalent)—you don't hand off to someone else to build

  • Has built and maintained a design system that more than one product or team depended on

  • Has real reps designing UX for AI-native products and is comfortable with the problems that don't exist in traditional software: non-determinism, streaming output, uncertainty, agentic flows, and earning user trust in machine output

  • Has a deep curiosity for how things work (an organization, a workflow, a market)

  • Isn't afraid to expose their ignorance and is constantly asking why

  • Has the poise and communication skills to earn trust with people who've never worked with a tech company before

  • Can sit with noisy, conflicting feedback from users and distill it into a clear opinion about what to build

  • Is willing to get on a plane with us

  • Is not above any task: up to draw the icon set, write the component, sit beside a user and watch them click, or wire up an off-the-shelf tool to test an idea fast.

 

Compensation

  • Competitive cash compensation ($150K–$300K depending on experience)

  • Founding equity, scaled to scope

Benefits

  • Health Insurance: Full healthcare, medical and dental

  • Retirement: 401(k)

  • PTO: Flexible time off

  • Travel: Company-paid

  • Office: HQ in New York City

Process

Our process takes about 2 weeks: a conversation with Tom or Mayank, a second founder conversation, a 60 minute technical interview, followed by a work trial where you'll get to meet the rest of the team and build with us for a day.

jobs.title: Principal
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Company

Eagle is on a mission to re-energize the engineering profession. Every road, water system, and power grid starts at an engineering firm. There are 40K+ of them in the US, and most run on software older than the engineers using it.

We partner deeply with engineering firms and build an AI-native operating system to give engineers superpowers: getting things done faster and better.

Eagle was founded by Mayank Mardia (CEO), Sohum Daftary (President), and Thomas Shouler, P.E. (CTO), and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

About the Role

As a Principal at Eagle, you'll report to Sohum (President) and work with the Founders across building strategic partnerships with great engineering firms, helping those firms grow, and supporting Eagle's operations. You'll be an extension of the Founders, and in some places a replacement.

We want you to own workstreams, important conversations, and meaningful decisions, to have a perspective, and to mobilize people to get things done.

In this role, you'll:

🤝 Earn trust onsite: Be onsite at our partner firms and earn the trust of firm leaders and engineers who've never worked with a tech company.

🗺️ Run the partnership cadence: Work with partner firm leadership on the 90-day plan, comp plan rollout, and key hires.

🔍 Own relationships with founder-owners: Meet founder-owners of engineering firms and own the relationship from first call to signed partnership. Keep it high touch, and solve for their objectives.

⚙️ Help run Eagle: Support Eagle's operations, including recruiting, logistics, and admin.

🚀 Build the partnership: Help transform our partner engineering firms, against an industry backdrop that’s barely been touched by AI.

📈 Grow as we grow: As we add partner firms, paths include leading new partnerships, operating roles at our partner firms, and senior roles at Eagle. We'll talk openly about where you want to go.

And there will be lots more, especially as you ideate through and materialize new opportunities within Eagle and our partner firms.

You Could Be a Great Fit If You:

Earn trust

  • Through excellent communication, nuance, and persuasion

  • By bringing people along with clarity, empathy, and intention

Show up

  • Get on a plane, then implement the ideas you come up with

  • Unblock the work by meeting people, understanding them, and getting folks aligned

Stay curious

  • Ask hard questions and listen

  • Learn fast and lean into new domains

  • Build systems and iterate

Professionally, you have 5+ years of experience in management consulting, IB / PE / VC, or start-up operations. Bonus points if you have started something of your own.

Process

Our process takes about 2 weeks: a conversation with Sohum or Mayank, a second founder conversation, an onsite where you walk us through a short case followed by dinner with the team, and references.


Working at Eagle

💰 Compensation

$200,000 to $250,000 salary and equity, depending on experience and scope.

❤️ Benefits

Health Insurance: Full healthcare, medical and dental

Retirement: 401(k)

PTO: Flexible time off

Travel: Company-paid

Office: HQ in New York City, open to you anytime


👥 From Mayank, Sohum, and Tom

We're nice! We promise. We're small, fast, and in-person in New York. We ask a lot of questions, build each other up as professionals, and focus on delivering great outcomes.

Sharing a little about us:

Mayank (CEO) is the son of an engineering firm owner in post-Katrina New Orleans. He studied computer science and Wharton finance at Penn (summa) and was a U.S. Presidential Scholar. He worked on applied AI at Bloomberg and as a PM at Ethic, and built insider-trading detection for the SEC.

Sohum (President) is a technology private equity investor. He studied electrical engineering and Wharton finance in Penn's M&T program (summa), then was a VP at Long Ridge Equity Partners, a technology and services middle-market private equity firm.

Tom (CTO) is a structural engineer turned software engineer. A Cornell grad and licensed P.E., he started at Arup, where he first built software inside the firm, then spent a decade at Palantir, Pivotal, and Replica deploying software within government agencies and Fortune 500s.


Equal Opportunity

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. Eagle is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we'll make it work.
